visualCharacteristics.purpose: one-at-a-time slider of featured hotels or restaurants: full-bleed image with an overlapping white panel (eyebrow, H3 name, description, CTA button / secondary link) and prev/next arrows
visualCharacteristics.structure: slides of image + overlapping panel with eyebrow + heading + text + CTAs; prev/next arrows

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = eyebrow paragraph (location / hotel name), h3 name (optionally linked), optional detail paragraph (e.g. 'Cuisine: ...'), description paragraph, CTA link(s) (e.g. 'Discover Now', or 'VIEW RESTAURANT' + 'BOOK A TABLE')
